<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>S.A. Sanitation Services | Septic &amp; Portable Restroom Service</title>
<meta name="description" content="S.A. Sanitation Services — septic tank pumping, porta potty rental &amp; cleaning, agricultural-friendly service. Se habla Español.">
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Oswald:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@500;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --navy-950:#05070f;
    --navy-900:#0a0f22;
    --navy-800:#0f1836;
    --blue-800:#0a2559;
    --blue-700:#0c2e73;
    --blue-600:#123b8f;
    --blue-500:#1c4fb0;
    --black:#0a0b0d;
    --steel-300:#c3c9d4;
    --steel-400:#9aa3b2;
    --steel-600:#5b6478;
    --white:#ffffff;
    --paper:#f4f5f8;
    --line: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
    --line-dark: rgba(10,15,34,0.10);
    --display: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
    --body: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    --mono: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
  }

  *{box-sizing:border-box; margin:0; padding:0;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{
    font-family: var(--body);
    background: var(--paper);
    color: var(--navy-950);
    line-height:1.5;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }
  img{max-width:100%; display:block;}
  a{color:inherit; text-decoration:none;}
  .container{max-width:1180px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 24px;}
  h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--display); font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.01em; text-transform:uppercase;}
  .eyebrow{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:12px;
    letter-spacing:0.14em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color: var(--blue-600);
    font-weight:700;
  }

  /* signature divider — chevron/motion-line motif echoing the logo's swoosh */
  .stripe-divider{
    height:10px;
    width:100%;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(
      -45deg,
      var(--blue-700) 0px, var(--blue-700) 22px,
      var(--black) 22px, var(--black) 44px
    );
  }
  .stripe-divider.thin{height:6px;}

  /* ---------- info bars — direct callback to the uploaded logo's own banner strips ---------- */
  .info-bars{display:flex; flex-direction:column;}
  .info-bar{
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex-wrap:wrap;
    gap:10px 28px;
    padding:11px 20px;
    font-family:var(--display);
    font-weight:600;
    font-size:14px;
    letter-spacing:0.03em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--white);
  }
  .info-bar.lang{background:var(--blue-700);}
  .info-bar.phones{background:var(--black);}
  .info-bar span{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;}
  .info-bar .sep{opacity:0.45; font-weight:400;}
  .info-bar a{color:var(--white);}
  .info-bar a:hover{color:var(--steel-300);}
  .check::before{content:"✓"; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:16px; height:16px; border:1.5px solid var(--white); border-radius:50%; font-size:10px;}
  .phone-ico::before{content:"☎"; font-size:14px;}

  /* ---------- header ---------- */
  header{
    position:sticky; top:0; z-index:50;
    background: var(--navy-950);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .header-row{
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
    padding:14px 24px;
    gap:16px;
  }
  .brand{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px;}
  .brand img{height:52px; width:auto;}
  .brand-name{
    font-family:var(--display);
    color:var(--white);
    font-size:15px;
    letter-spacing:0.06em;
    line-height:1.2;
  }
  .brand-name span{display:block; font-size:10px; color:var(--steel-400); letter-spacing:0.12em; font-family:var(--mono); text-transform:uppercase; margin-top:2px;}

  .header-actions{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;}
  .lang-toggle{
    display:flex; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:999px; overflow:hidden;
    font-family:var(--mono); font-size:12px; font-weight:700;
  }
  .lang-toggle button{
    background:transparent; border:none; color:var(--steel-400);
    padding:7px 14px; cursor:pointer; letter-spacing:0.05em;
  }
  .lang-toggle button.active{background:var(--blue-600); color:var(--white);}

  .call-pill{
    display:none;
    align-items:center; gap:8px;
    background:var(--blue-700);
    color:var(--white);
    padding:9px 16px;
    border-radius:999px;
    font-family:var(--mono); font-weight:700; font-size:13px;
    white-space:nowrap;
  }
  @media(min-width:860px){ .call-pill{display:flex;} }

  /* ---------- hero ---------- */
  .hero{
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 85% -10%, rgba(18,59,143,0.35), transparent 55%),
      var(--navy-950);
    color:var(--white);
    padding:64px 0 0 0;
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .hero-grid{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:40px;
    align-items:center;
    padding-bottom:56px;
  }
  @media(min-width:900px){ .hero-grid{grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;} }

  .hero .eyebrow{margin-bottom:18px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; color:var(--steel-300);}
  .hero .eyebrow::before{content:""; width:26px; height:2px; background:var(--blue-500); display:inline-block;}

  .hero h1{
    font-size:clamp(34px, 5.4vw, 58px);
    line-height:1.04;
    color:var(--white);
  }
  .hero h1 em{
    font-style:normal;
    color:var(--steel-300);
  }
  .hero p.lede{
    font-family:var(--body);
    font-size:17px;
    color:var(--steel-300);
    margin-top:20px;
    max-width:46ch;
    text-transform:none;
  }

  .hero-ctas{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:12px; margin-top:32px;}
  .btn{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-weight:700;
    font-size:14px;
    letter-spacing:0.03em;
    padding:15px 22px;
    border-radius:2px;
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
    border:1px solid transparent;
    transition:transform .15s ease, background .15s ease;
  }
  .btn:active{transform:translateY(1px);}
  .btn-primary{background:var(--blue-600); color:var(--white);}
  .btn-primary:hover{background:var(--blue-500);}
  .btn-outline{border-color:var(--line); color:var(--white); background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03);}
  .btn-outline:hover{border-color:var(--steel-400);}

  .hero-bilingual-badge{
    margin-top:26px;
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
    font-family:var(--mono); font-size:12px; color:var(--steel-300);
    border:1px solid var(--line); padding:8px 14px; border-radius:999px;
  }
  .hero-bilingual-badge b{color:var(--white);}

  .hero-card{
    background:var(--navy-900);
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    padding:34px;
    position:relative;
  }
  .hero-card img{width:100%; max-width:340px; margin:0 auto 22px; filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.45));}
  .hero-card-line{
    display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:baseline;
    padding:12px 0; border-top:1px solid var(--line);
    font-family:var(--mono); font-size:13px; color:var(--steel-300);
  }
  .hero-card-line:first-of-type{border-top:none;}
  .hero-card-line b{color:var(--white); font-size:15px;}

  /* ---------- services ---------- */
  .section{padding:72px 0;}
  .section-head{max-width:640px; margin-bottom:44px;}
  .section-head h2{font-size:clamp(26px,3.4vw,36px); margin-top:12px;}
  .section-head p{color:var(--steel-600); margin-top:14px; font-size:15.5px; text-transform:none; font-family:var(--body);}

  .services-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:1px; background:var(--line-dark); border:1px solid var(--line-dark);}
  @media(min-width:760px){ .services-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);} }
  .service-card{background:var(--white); padding:32px 28px;}
  .service-card .num{font-family:var(--mono); color:var(--blue-600); font-size:12px; font-weight:700;}
  .service-card h3{font-size:19px; margin-top:14px; color:var(--navy-950);}
  .service-card p{margin-top:10px; color:var(--steel-600); font-size:14.5px; text-transform:none; font-family:var(--body);}
  .service-card .tag{
    display:inline-block; margin-top:16px; font-family:var(--mono); font-size:11px;
    color:var(--blue-700); border:1px solid rgba(12,46,115,0.25); padding:4px 9px; border-radius:999px;
  }

  /* ---------- ag band (signature moment) ---------- */
  .ag-band{
    background:var(--blue-700);
    color:var(--white);
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
    padding:64px 0;
  }
  .ag-band::before{
    content:"";
    position:absolute; inset:0;
    background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(
      0deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 0px, rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 2px,
      transparent 2px, transparent 34px
    );
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  .ag-inner{position:relative; display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:28px;}
  @media(min-width:860px){ .ag-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; align-items:center;} }
  .ag-band h2{color:var(--white); font-size:clamp(24px,3.2vw,32px);}
  .ag-band .eyebrow{color:var(--steel-300);}
  .ag-band p{color:rgba(255,255,255,0.85); margin-top:14px; font-family:var(--body); text-transform:none; font-size:15.5px; max-width:52ch;}
  .ag-points{list-style:none; margin-top:22px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px;}
  .ag-points li{display:flex; gap:12px; font-family:var(--mono); font-size:13.5px; color:var(--white);}
  .ag-points li::before{content:"—"; color:var(--steel-300);}

  /* ---------- why / trust ---------- */
  .trust-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:28px;}
  @media(min-width:760px){ .trust-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);} }
  .trust-item h3{font-size:15px; color:var(--navy-950); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;}
  .trust-item h3::before{content:""; width:8px; height:8px; background:var(--blue-600); display:inline-block;}
  .trust-item p{margin-top:10px; color:var(--steel-600); font-size:14.5px; text-transform:none; font-family:var(--body);}

  /* ---------- contact ---------- */
  .contact{background:var(--navy-950); color:var(--white); padding:76px 0;}
  .contact-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:40px;}
  @media(min-width:900px){ .contact-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;} }
  .contact h2{color:var(--white); font-size:clamp(26px,3.4vw,34px);}
  .contact-desc{color:var(--steel-300); margin-top:14px; font-family:var(--body); text-transform:none; font-size:15.5px; max-width:48ch;}

  .contact-lines{margin-top:28px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:0;}
  .contact-line{
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
    padding:18px 0; border-top:1px solid var(--line);
    gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap;
  }
  .contact-line .label{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:11.5px; color:var(--steel-400); letter-spacing:0.08em; text-transform:uppercase;}
  .contact-line .value{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:20px; font-weight:700; color:var(--white);}
  .contact-line .value:hover{color:var(--steel-300);}
  .contact-line small{display:block; font-family:var(--body); font-weight:400; font-size:12px; color:var(--steel-400); margin-top:4px; text-transform:none;}

  .contact-card{
    background:var(--navy-900); border:1px solid var(--line); padding:32px;
  }
  .contact-card .eyebrow{margin-bottom:8px; color:var(--steel-300);}
  .contact-card h3{color:var(--white); font-size:18px;}
  .contact-card p{color:var(--steel-300); margin-top:12px; font-family:var(--body); text-transform:none; font-size:14.5px;}
  .contact-card .btn{width:100%; justify-content:center; margin-top:22px;}
  .contact-card .btn + .btn{margin-top:12px;}

  /* ---------- footer ---------- */
  footer{background:var(--black); color:var(--steel-400); padding:32px 0;}
  .footer-row{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:16px;}
  .footer-brand{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;}
  .footer-brand img{height:30px;}
  .footer-brand span{font-family:var(--display); color:var(--white); font-size:13px; letter-spacing:0.05em;}
  footer .fine{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:11.5px;}

  [data-i18n-es]{ }
  .lang-es [data-i18n-en]{display:none;}
  .lang-es [data-i18n-es]{display:inline;}
  [data-i18n-es]{display:none;}

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    html{scroll-behavior:auto;}
    .btn{transition:none;}
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header>
  <div class="header-row">
    <div class="brand">
      <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="S.A. Sanitation Services logo">
      <div class="brand-name">S.A. SANITATION SERVICES
        <span data-i18n-en>Septic &amp; Portable Restroom Service</span>
        <span data-i18n-es>Servicio Séptico y Baños Portátiles</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="header-actions">
      <a class="call-pill" href="tel:8053635363">☎ (805) 363-5363</a>
      <div class="lang-toggle" role="group" aria-label="Language toggle">
        <button type="button" id="btn-en" class="active">EN</button>
        <button type="button" id="btn-es">ES</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="info-bars">
    <div class="info-bar lang">
      <span class="check">We Speak English</span>
      <span class="sep">|</span>
      <span class="check">Hablamos Español</span>
    </div>
    <div class="info-bar phones">
      <a class="phone-ico" href="tel:8053635363">805-363-5363</a>
      <span class="sep">|</span>
      <a class="phone-ico" href="tel:8202287096">820-228-7096</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</header>

<section class="hero">
  <div class="container hero-grid">
    <div>
      <div class="eyebrow">
        <span data-i18n-en>Licensed Service · Se Habla Español</span>
        <span data-i18n-es>Servicio Confiable · English Spoken</span>
      </div>
      <h1>
        <span data-i18n-en>Septic &amp; porta&nbsp;potty service, <em>done right.</em></span>
        <span data-i18n-es>Servicio de séptico y baños portátiles, <em>hecho bien.</em></span>
      </h1>
      <p class="lede">
        <span data-i18n-en>S.A. Sanitation Services pumps, cleans, and maintains septic systems and portable restrooms for homes, job sites, events, and farms — and we're proudly agricultural-friendly.</span>
        <span data-i18n-es>S.A. Sanitation Services bombea, limpia y mantiene sistemas sépticos y baños portátiles para casas, obras, eventos y ranchos — y trabajamos con gusto en el sector agrícola.</span>
      </p>

      <div class="hero-ctas">
        <a class="btn btn-primary" href="tel:8053635363">
          <span data-i18n-en>Call (805) 363-5363</span>
          <span data-i18n-es>Llame al (805) 363-5363</span>
        </a>
        <a class="btn btn-outline" href="tel:8202287096">
          <span data-i18n-en>Call (820) 228-7096</span>
          <span data-i18n-es>Llame al (820) 228-7096</span>
        </a>
        <a class="btn btn-outline" href="mailto:sasanitationllc@gmail.com">
          <span data-i18n-en>Email Us</span>
          <span data-i18n-es>Envíenos un Correo</span>
        </a>
      </div>

      <div class="hero-bilingual-badge">
        <b>EN</b> English &amp; <b>ES</b> Español —
        <span data-i18n-en>our team speaks both, every call.</span>
        <span data-i18n-es>nuestro equipo habla los dos, en cada llamada.</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="hero-card">
      <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="S.A. Sanitation Services">
      <div class="hero-card-line">
        <span data-i18n-en>Dispatch</span><span data-i18n-es>Despacho</span>
        <b>(805) 363-5363</b>
      </div>
      <div class="hero-card-line">
        <span data-i18n-en>Alt. Line</span><span data-i18n-es>Línea Alterna</span>
        <b>(820) 228-7096</b>
      </div>
      <div class="hero-card-line">
        <span data-i18n-en>Email</span><span data-i18n-es>Correo</span>
        <b style="font-size:13px;">sasanitationllc@gmail.com</b>
      </div>
      <div class="hero-card-line">
        <span data-i18n-en>Agricultural Accounts</span><span data-i18n-es>Cuentas Agrícolas</span>
        <b data-i18n-en>Welcome</b><b data-i18n-es>Bienvenidas</b>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="stripe-divider thin"></div>

<section class="section" id="services">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-head">
      <div class="eyebrow" data-i18n-en>What We Do</div>
      <div class="eyebrow" data-i18n-es>Lo Que Hacemos</div>
      <h2 data-i18n-en>Full-service septic &amp; sanitation</h2>
      <h2 data-i18n-es>Servicio completo de séptico y sanitación</h2>
      <p data-i18n-en>From routine pumping to event rentals, our trucks are equipped, our crew is bilingual, and our scheduling is straightforward.</p>
      <p data-i18n-es>Desde bombeo de rutina hasta rentas para eventos, nuestros camiones están equipados, nuestro equipo es bilingüe y programar el servicio es fácil.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="services-grid">
      <div class="service-card">
        <div class="num">01</div>
        <h3 data-i18n-en>Septic Tank Pumping &amp; Cleaning</h3>
        <h3 data-i18n-es>Bombeo y Limpieza de Tanques Sépticos</h3>
        <p data-i18n-en>Routine and emergency pumping, tank cleaning, and inspections for residential and commercial systems.</p>
        <p data-i18n-es>Bombeo de rutina y de emergencia, limpieza de tanques e inspecciones para sistemas residenciales y comerciales.</p>
        <span class="tag" data-i18n-en>Residential · Commercial</span>
        <span class="tag" data-i18n-es>Residencial · Comercial</span>
      </div>
      <div class="service-card">
        <div class="num">02</div>
        <h3 data-i18n-en>Porta Potty Rental &amp; Cleaning</h3>
        <h3 data-i18n-es>Renta y Limpieza de Baños Portátiles</h3>
        <p data-i18n-en>Clean, well-stocked portable restrooms delivered and serviced for job sites, events, and long-term rentals.</p>
        <p data-i18n-es>Baños portátiles limpios y bien abastecidos, entregados y mantenidos para obras, eventos y rentas a largo plazo.</p>
        <span class="tag" data-i18n-en>Events · Job Sites</span>
        <span class="tag" data-i18n-es>Eventos · Obras</span>
      </div>
      <div class="service-card">
        <div class="num">03</div>
        <h3 data-i18n-en>Agricultural Service</h3>
        <h3 data-i18n-es>Servicio Agrícola</h3>
        <p data-i18n-en>Septic and restroom service built around field crews, harvest schedules, and ranch access — ag-friendly, every visit.</p>
        <p data-i18n-es>Servicio séptico y de baños pensado para cuadrillas de campo, horarios de cosecha y acceso a ranchos — amigable con la agricultura, siempre.</p>
        <span class="tag" data-i18n-en>Farms · Ranches</span>
        <span class="tag" data-i18n-es>Ranchos · Fincas</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="ag-band">
  <div class="container ag-inner">
    <div>
      <div class="eyebrow" data-i18n-en>Agricultural-Friendly</div>
      <div class="eyebrow" data-i18n-es>Amigables con la Agricultura</div>
      <h2 data-i18n-en>Built to work around your fields, not against them.</h2>
      <h2 data-i18n-es>Trabajamos alrededor de sus campos, no en contra de ellos.</h2>
      <p data-i18n-en>We know ranch roads, gate codes, and harvest windows matter as much as the service itself. We schedule around field crews and work directly with foremen and ranch managers.</p>
      <p data-i18n-es>Sabemos que los caminos del rancho, los códigos de portones y las temporadas de cosecha importan tanto como el servicio mismo. Programamos alrededor de las cuadrillas y trabajamos directamente con mayordomos y encargados de rancho.</p>
    </div>
    <ul class="ag-points">
      <li data-i18n-en>Flexible scheduling around harvest and planting seasons</li>
      <li data-i18n-es>Horarios flexibles según la cosecha y la siembra</li>
      <li data-i18n-en>Portable restrooms for field crews, on rotation</li>
      <li data-i18n-es>Baños portátiles para cuadrillas de campo, en rotación</li>
      <li data-i18n-en>Bilingual crews who work directly with field staff</li>
      <li data-i18n-es>Cuadrillas bilingües que trabajan directo con el personal de campo</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="section" id="why">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-head">
      <div class="eyebrow" data-i18n-en>Why S.A. Sanitation</div>
      <div class="eyebrow" data-i18n-es>Por Qué S.A. Sanitation</div>
      <h2 data-i18n-en>Straightforward service, both languages</h2>
      <h2 data-i18n-es>Servicio directo, en los dos idiomas</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="trust-grid">
      <div class="trust-item">

<script>
  var btnEn = document.getElementById('btn-en');
  var btnEs = document.getElementById('btn-es');
  function setLang(lang){
    if(lang === 'es'){
      document.body.classList.add('lang-es');
      btnEs.classList.add('active');
      btnEn.classList.remove('active');
      document.documentElement.lang = 'es';
    } else {
      document.body.classList.remove('lang-es');
      btnEn.classList.add('active');
      btnEs.classList.remove('active');
      document.documentElement.lang = 'en';
    }
  }
  btnEn.addEventListener('click', function(){ setLang('en'); });
  btnEs.addEventListener('click', function(){ setLang('es'); });
</script>
